name: default-marquee

frames.best_why: Frame 3 shows both rows with several complete cards and readable names, with the cursor clear of them.

tagline: Two rows of review cards drift in opposite directions, pausing on hover.
summary: Two horizontal strips of testimonial cards loop endlessly, one drifting left and the other right. Each card carries a coloured avatar dot, a name, a handle and a short quote, and hover freezes the motion.
appearance: On a near-black field, two rows of dark rounded review cards with a faint blue glow along their base. Each card has a small coloured circle avatar, a bold name, a grey handle and two lines of white quote text. Cards are clipped and faded at both screen edges.
behaviour: Both rows scroll continuously in opposite directions and loop without a visible seam. Hovering any card freezes its strip so a quote can be read; moving away restarts the drift. Fade masks hide the cut ends at each side.
demo_content: Six reviewers named Jack, Jill, John, Jane, Jenny and James with handles and one-line praise.
search_phrases: reviews ticker that pauses on hover
use_when: You want a dense wall of short customer quotes to keep moving without a carousel control.
avoid_when: Quotes come from six hardcoded reviews, and constant motion makes a quiet page harder to read.
customise: The review list, names, handles, quotes and avatar colours live in a local array, so edit it there. Strip speed, direction and fade colours are set through class names.
weight_why: A handful of cards on two CSS-driven strips plus one noise overlay.

a11y.note: Motion never stops except on hover and cannot be paused by keyboard; avatar dots have no text alternative.

issues: Handles are drawn at 40% white on dark cards, so the secondary text is hard to read.
polish_why: Tidy cards and smooth fades, but the pattern and repeated praise quotes feel standard.
title: Default Marquee
